basic_info.description: Rarely available on coveted Woodland Avenue, this 1927 single-family home blends architectural elegance with thoughtful modern upgrades. With approximately 1,978 sq ft of living space, the residence offers scale, natural light, and a coveted setting in Cole Valley/Parnassus Heights. A welcoming foyer leads to formal living and dining rooms with coved ceilings, original moldings, and a wood-burning fireplace that reflects the home's period character. The renovated kitchen features custom cabinetry, quartz surfaces, premium appliances, and a skylight that bathes the space in natural light. A half bath is conveniently located just off the kitchen. Double French doors open directly to the deck and terraced garden, extending the living area outdoors for entertaining or quiet retreat. Upstairs, three bedrooms capture abundant light and outlooks to treetops, the downtown skyline, and St. Ignatius. The full bath has been refreshed with a hexagonal marble tile floor, new vanity, and designer finishes. A large garage with updated flooring provides parking, storage, and laundry. Set on a quiet, tree-lined street, the home offers rare tranquility just moments from the cafes of Cole Valley, the cultural vibrancy of Haight-Ashbury, and the trails of Mt. Sutro.
